testCases.query: Create a Grafana dashboard for my service
expectedBehavior: Includes Golden Signals panels (latency, traffic, errors, saturation)
Defines SLO/SLI targets with error budgets
Adds health check endpoints (liveness, readiness, startup)
Shows RED method metrics in dashboard layout

testCases.query: Set up Langfuse tracing for my LLM application
expectedBehavior: Uses @observe decorator with get_client() API
Sets user_id and session_id via update_current_trace
Configures OpenTelemetry SpanProcessor for distributed trace export
Uses observation types for Agent Graph rendering

testCases.query: Our agents sometimes return wrong results without any errors. How do I detect these silent failures?
expectedBehavior: Implements statistical baseline anomaly detection using z-score or similar statistical methods
Detects failures that produce no errors but deliver incorrect or degraded results
Uses historical baselines to identify when output metrics deviate from normal distribution
Goes beyond exception-based alerting to catch silent degradation that error handlers miss

testCases.query: How do I detect when my LLM agent starts producing gibberish or repetitive output that passes basic checks?
expectedBehavior: Uses heuristic pre-filters for cheap fast detection of obviously degraded output quality
Applies LLM-as-judge evaluation for nuanced quality scoring beyond simple length checks
Integrates with Langfuse observe decorator for quality check trace logging and monitoring
Catches outputs that pass basic emptiness checks but contain gibberish or repetitive content

testCases.query: Our agent sometimes fabricates answers from training data instead of using the search tool. How do I catch this?
expectedBehavior: Validates tool usage against expected tool call patterns for each query type
Detects when agents skip expected tool calls and produce plausible but wrong results
Uses Langfuse trace analysis to compare actual tool invocations against expected patterns
Flags results produced without required tool calls as potentially fabricated from training data

testCases.query: Add Prometheus metrics and PSI drift detection to my LLM service
expectedBehavior: Points at first-party Prometheus and drift-detection documentation instead of restating it
Does not invent a local copy of PSI, KS test, or Prometheus metric-type tutorials
Surfaces the OrchestKit delta that upstream does not carry (TRACEPARENT propagation, OTEL_* subprocess stripping, JSONL hook telemetry)
Keeps bounded label cardinality guidance when instrumenting
